integrity: Direct exhaustive tests for 19 finite alphabet/length combinations corroborate; infinite results depend on the proof. Binary one-length ball statistics are existing results, not claimed new. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent alphabet symbols; exact consecutive deletion bursts; pairwise statements concern distinct burst lengths, as does the third-moment formula. No new coding-capacity bounds or assertions for fixed-composition sources.
title: Sharp cross-length dependence law for burst-deletion balls
